## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mcsubregiterator">MCSubRegIterator</a> enumerates all sub-registers of Reg.</p>


<p>If IncludeSelf is set, Reg itself is included in the list.</p>


<p>Definition at line 520 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/mc/mcregisterinfo-h">MCRegisterInfo.h</a>.</p>
